en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Khalid, from Shareef Bin Sabiq, from Al Fazl Bin Abu Gurra, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The foolishness is a lowly mannerism. He would extend (himself) upon the one who is below him, and he would succumb to the one who is above him’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Sharif ibn Sabiq from al-Fadl ibn abu Qurrah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Dimwittedness is a bad attitude. Such an individual intimidates those below him and is humble (inferior) before those above him.’”
